kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استرققت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْقَقْتُ (istarqaqtu) /is.tar.qaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
# اِسْتَرْقَقْتَ (istarqaqta) /is.tar.qaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
# اِسْتَرْقَقْتِ (istarqaqti) /is.tar.qaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
# اُسْتُرْقِقْتُ (usturqiqtu) /us.tur.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
